entity_raw.definition_raw:
You drink blood from the living at a furious rate, often draining creatures dry in a matter of seconds.

Prerequisite(s): Blood drain universal monster ability, grab universal monster ability.

Benefit(s): Once per round, when you successfully pin an opponent, that opponent takes double the normal damage from your blood drain.
